reasons: The cited clause (Section 14(a)) selects Delaware law with exclusive venue in New York state and federal courts — Delaware law is an express fallback and US courts (not foreign arbitration) satisfy the forum requirement, so 'compliant' is the correct classification under the playbook's semantics.
No redline or comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirms the governing law is within the accepted set.

The rationale correctly notes the sub-preferred choice of law (Delaware vs. New York) and the internal tension with the AAA arbitration clause in Section 8 as observations rather than deviations; the AAA arbitration has no foreign seat, so it is not walk-away territory.
